description: I want to share an important update regarding the Community Round Table events that were scheduled for this week. After a great deal of consideration, I made the difficult decision to cancel both sessions. A few unexpected challenges came together all at once: Health issues, complications with our promotional efforts, and an unplanned return home…

title: Community Round Table Update – Elect Joshua Brant
